## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising) and QQQ (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +18.21%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising) show equity strength while core risk ratios are neutral, supporting the NEUTRAL read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit lightening: HYG (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND (→ flat) and LQD (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +0.50%) ABOVE TREND (→ flat) modestly higher. Fear easing: VXX (1W: -3.27% | 1M: -19.85%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-accommodative: UUP (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling) with TLT (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -0.28%) RECOVERY (→ flat) — yields and dollar are balanced, keeping conditions neither tight nor loose.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leadership: XLK (1W: +6.86% | 1M: +23.72%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising) with SOXX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +45.75%) ABOVE TREND confirming chip strength. Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling); style: Growth/momentum showing strength while Financials (XLF) has a short-term correction.

5. US vs Global?  
US strong: SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND; EM participation notable with EEM (1W: +7.66% | 1M: +17.76%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND — global risk-on tone but not one-sided.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Healthy speculative bid: IBIT (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +18.13%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +8.23% | 1M: +15.74%) ABOVE TREND, with IWM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +13.40%) ABOVE TREND showing small-cap participation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial metals strength: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising); precious metals mixed with GLD (1W: +3.25% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY (↑ rising) and SLV (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy under pressure: BNO (1W: -8.98% | 1M: +0.02%) CORRECTION and XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling); USO (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND confirms sector weakness.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Broad equities and Tech (XLK, QQQ, SPY) show multi-timeframe confirmation (ABOVE TREND). Minor divergence: XLF (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.93%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -0.28%) RECOVERY create 1W/1M mismatches but do not negate the overall equity advance.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposure via XLK (1W: +6.86% | 1M: +23.72%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +18.21%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND and monitor TLT (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -0.28%) RECOVERY for duration signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +6.86% | 1M: +23.72%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +45.75%) ABOVE TREND if semis momentum continues. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -8.98% | 1M: +0.02%) CORRECTION if oil weakness persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND for cyclicals/industrial reflation. BEARISH: USO (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND and BNO CORRECTION as energy volatility could pressure related sectors.

13. Key Levels?  
Watch VXX (1W: -3.27% | 1M: -19.85%) BELOW TREND — sub-20 complacency threshold; monitor HYG (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +0.50%) ABOVE TREND for credit health. Track XLK (1W: +6.86% | 1M: +23.72%) ABOVE TREND vs XLF (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.93%) CORRECTION as a style pivot metric.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, but core risk ratios remain neutral, supporting a balanced stance. Tech and growth (XLK, QQQ, SOXX) are showing strength while energy (XLE, BNO) is a clear weakness to monitor as the primary divergence.
